CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_guard_managed_game_lifecycle()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_is_engine boolean := COALESCE(auth.role(), '') = 'service_role';
  v_managed_command boolean :=
    COALESCE(current_setting('app.managed_game_lifecycle', true), '') = 'on';
  v_protected_tournament_keys text[] := ARRAY[
    'name', 'start_time', 'max_players', 'buy_in_amount', 'buy_in_fee',
    'guaranteed_prize', 'late_reg_mins', 'starting_chips', 'blind_structure',
    'payout_structure', 'game_type', 'variant', 'tournament_type', 'is_rebuy',
    'rebuy_cost', 'rebuy_chips', 'rebuy_levels', 'add_on_available',
    'addon_cost', 'addon_chips', 'is_bounty', 'bounty_amount', 'is_pko',
    'is_mystery_bounty', 'mystery_bounty_min', 'mystery_bounty_max',
    'description', 'short_description', 'min_players', 'late_reg_levels',
    'is_reentry', 'max_rebuys', 'max_reentries', 'addon_levels',
    'addon_break_minutes', 'is_private', 'is_vip_only', 'ban_chat',
    'all_in_or_fold', 'label_as_new', 'hide_club_name', 'is_pinned',
    'action_time_seconds', 'table_size', 'accelerated_mtt', 'big_blind_ante',
    'authorized_to_register', 'early_bird_enabled', 'early_bird_chips',
    'bubble_protection', 'final_table_deal_enabled', 'restart_every_minutes',
    'synchronized_breaks', 'is_multi_day', 'total_days', 'is_xmtt',
    'union_id', 'satellite_target_id', 'satellite_seats', 'spin_type',
    'mystery_bounty_profile', 'mystery_bounty_activation',
    'mystery_bounty_activation_value', 'mystery_bounty_pool_percent',
    'mystery_bounty_top_percent', 'settings'
  ];
  v_original_abort_admission boolean := false;
  v_key text;
  v_new_document jsonb;
  v_old_document jsonb;
BEGIN
  IF TG_TABLE_NAME='tournaments' AND session_user='postgres' AND current_user='postgres'
     AND coalesce(current_setting('role',true),'none') IN ('none','postgres') AND auth.role() IS NULL
     AND NEW.status='CANCELLED' THEN
    SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM smarter_private.tournament_abort_targets a
      JOIN public.engine_tournament_leases l ON l.tournament_id=a.tournament_id
      JOIN public.tournament_escrow e ON e.tournament_id=a.tournament_id
      WHERE a.tournament_id=NEW.id AND a.state='quiesced'
        AND ((a.receipt->>'mode'='started_operator_abort_admission' AND OLD.status IN ('RUNNING','BREAK','LATE_REG'))
          OR (a.receipt->>'mode'='owner_retirement_admission' AND OLD.status='COMPLETING'))
        AND (a.receipt->>'transaction_id')::bigint=txid_current()
        AND l.protocol_version=2 AND l.heartbeat_at>=clock_timestamp()-make_interval(secs=>public.fn_engine_lease_stale_seconds())
        AND a.quiescence->>'generation'=l.lease_generation::text
        AND e.enforced AND e.closed_at IS NOT NULL
        AND e.prize_balance=0 AND e.bounty_balance=0 AND e.fee_balance=0)
    INTO v_original_abort_admission;
  END IF;
  IF current_user = 'postgres' THEN
    IF TG_TABLE_NAME='tournaments' AND public.fn_ca_midway_free_buy_conversion_transition(to_jsonb(OLD),to_jsonb(NEW)) THEN RETURN NEW; END IF;
  END IF;

  IF TG_TABLE_NAME='tournaments' THEN
  IF current_user='postgres'
     AND OLD.id='6b72abc3-bd16-488c-aea5-54b1eace98d5'::uuid
     AND OLD.status='RUNNING' AND NEW.status='RUNNING'
     AND OLD.prize_pool=5000 AND NEW.prize_pool=4050
     AND OLD.guaranteed_prize=5000 AND NEW.guaranteed_prize=5000
     AND OLD.bounty_pool=950 AND NEW.bounty_pool=950
     AND OLD.prize_pool_finalized AND NEW.prize_pool_finalized
     AND (to_jsonb(NEW)-ARRAY['prize_pool','payout_structure'])
       =(to_jsonb(OLD)-ARRAY['prize_pool','payout_structure'])
     AND current_setting('app.owner_bounty_guarantee_correction',true)=
       'tourney:6b72abc3-bd16-488c-aea5-54b1eace98d5:owner_bounty_guarantee_20261102'
     AND EXISTS (
       SELECT 1 FROM public.chip_ledger l
       WHERE l.idempotency_key=current_setting('app.owner_bounty_guarantee_correction',true)
         AND l.tournament_id=OLD.id AND l.category='reversal' AND l.amount=950
         AND l.from_type='prize_liability' AND l.from_entity_id=OLD.id
         AND l.to_type='union_bank'
         AND l.to_entity_id='fade0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001'::uuid
         AND l.metadata->>'kind'='owner_bounty_guarantee_correction'
         AND l.metadata->'tournament_before'=to_jsonb(OLD)
         AND l.metadata->'tournament_after'=to_jsonb(NEW)
         AND l.metadata->>'overlay_after'='1580'
         AND l.metadata->>'owner_instruction'=
           'go through and manually change the payout to the corrected 5000 prize pool and pay the overlay'
     ) THEN
    RETURN NEW;
  END IF;
  END IF;
  IF TG_TABLE_NAME = 'tables' THEN
    IF lower(COALESCE(NEW.status, '')) IN ('closed', 'deleted')
       AND lower(COALESCE(OLD.status, '')) NOT IN ('closed', 'deleted')
       AND EXISTS (
         SELECT 1
         FROM public.table_seats ts
         WHERE ts.table_id = NEW.id
           AND ts.left_at IS NULL
       ) THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'This table cannot be closed while players are seated'
        USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';
    END IF;

    IF NOT v_is_engine
       AND NOT v_managed_command
       AND (
         lower(COALESCE(NEW.status, '')) = 'deleted'
         AND lower(COALESCE(OLD.status, '')) <> 'deleted'
         OR COALESCE(NEW.is_deleted, false) AND NOT COALESCE(OLD.is_deleted, false)
       ) THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'Table lifecycle changes must use fn_close_managed_game'
        USING ERRCODE = '42501';
    END IF;
    RETURN NEW;
  END IF;

  IF TG_TABLE_NAME = 'tournaments'
     AND EXISTS (
       SELECT 1
       FROM public.tournament_players tp
       WHERE tp.tournament_id = NEW.id
     ) THEN
    IF NOT v_is_engine
       AND NOT v_original_abort_admission
       AND upper(COALESCE(NEW.status, '')) IN ('CANCELLED', 'CANCELED')
       AND upper(COALESCE(OLD.status, '')) NOT IN ('CANCELLED', 'CANCELED')
       AND COALESCE(current_setting('app.poker_diamond_staff_cancel', true), '') IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.id::text THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'This tournament cannot be cancelled after a player has registered'
        USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';
    END IF;

    IF NOT v_is_engine THEN
      v_new_document := to_jsonb(NEW);
      v_old_document := to_jsonb(OLD);
      FOREACH v_key IN ARRAY v_protected_tournament_keys LOOP
        CONTINUE WHEN v_key = 'guaranteed_prize'
          AND current_user = 'postgres'
          AND COALESCE(current_setting('app.owner_remove_guarantee_over_1k', true), '') = 'on'
          AND upper(COALESCE(OLD.status, '')) IN ('ANNOUNCED', 'REGISTERING', 'SCHEDULED', 'PENDING')
          AND NOT COALESCE(OLD.prize_pool_finalized, false)
          AND COALESCE(OLD.guaranteed_prize, 0) > 1000
          AND COALESCE(NEW.guaranteed_prize, 0) = 0;
        CONTINUE WHEN v_key IN ('name', 'short_description', 'description')
          AND jsonb_typeof(v_old_document -> v_key) = 'string'
          AND (v_new_document ->> v_key) IS NOT DISTINCT FROM
              public.fn_ca_text_without_dollar(v_old_document ->> v_key);
        CONTINUE WHEN v_key IN ('name', 'short_description', 'description')
          AND NEW.club_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM OLD.club_id
          AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.clubs c WHERE c.id = NEW.club_id AND c.asset = 'diamonds')
          AND jsonb_typeof(v_old_document -> v_key) = 'string'
          AND (v_new_document ->> v_key) IS NOT DISTINCT FROM
              public.fn_ca_diamond_guarantee_copy(v_old_document ->> v_key);
        CONTINUE WHEN v_key IN ('blind_structure', 'late_reg_mins', 'late_reg_levels', 'rebuy_levels')
          AND current_user = 'postgres'
          AND COALESCE(current_setting('app.lock_level_clock', true), '') = 'on'
          AND upper(COALESCE(OLD.status, '')) IN ('ANNOUNCED', 'REGISTERING', 'SCHEDULED', 'PENDING');
        CONTINUE WHEN v_key IN ('is_rebuy', 'is_reentry', 'rebuy_cost', 'rebuy_chips', 'rebuy_levels', 'max_rebuys', 'max_reentries')
          AND current_user = 'postgres'
          AND COALESCE(current_setting('app.bounty_rebuy_rule', true), '') = 'on'
          AND COALESCE(NEW.is_rebuy, false)
          AND upper(COALESCE(OLD.status, '')) IN ('ANNOUNCED', 'REGISTERING');
        CONTINUE WHEN v_key IN ('mystery_bounty_pool_percent', 'mystery_bounty_activation', 'mystery_bounty_activation_value', 'short_description')
          AND current_user = 'postgres'
          AND COALESCE(current_setting('app.mystery_terms_rule', true), '') = 'on'
          AND upper(COALESCE(OLD.status, '')) IN ('ANNOUNCED', 'REGISTERING');
        CONTINUE WHEN v_key='late_reg_mins' AND current_user='postgres'
          AND NEW.club_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM OLD.club_id
          AND OLD.tournament_type='MTT' AND OLD.late_reg_mins=8
          AND OLD.late_reg_levels>0 AND NOT COALESCE(OLD.prize_pool_finalized,false)
          AND (OLD.status IN ('ANNOUNCED','REGISTERING') OR
               (OLD.status='RUNNING' AND COALESCE(OLD.current_level,0)<OLD.late_reg_levels))
          AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.clubs c WHERE c.id=OLD.club_id AND c.asset='diamonds' AND c.is_platform IS TRUE)
          AND NEW.late_reg_mins=public.fn_ca_mtt_late_registration_minutes(OLD.blind_structure::jsonb,OLD.late_reg_levels);
        CONTINUE WHEN v_key = 'addon_break_minutes'
          AND current_user = 'postgres'
          AND COALESCE(current_setting('app.addon_break_rule', true), '') = 'on'
          AND NEW.addon_break_minutes = 1
          AND upper(COALESCE(OLD.status, '')) IN ('ANNOUNCED', 'REGISTERING');
        CONTINUE WHEN v_key = 'payout_structure'
          AND NOT COALESCE(OLD.prize_pool_finalized, false)
          AND NOT COALESCE(NEW.prize_pool_finalized, false)
          AND public.fn_safe_jsonb_array(NEW.payout_structure::text)
              IS NOT DISTINCT FROM public.fn_ca_provisional_payout_structure(NEW.id);
        IF (v_new_document -> v_key) IS DISTINCT FROM (v_old_document -> v_key) THEN
          RAISE EXCEPTION 'This tournament cannot be modified after a player has registered'
            USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';
        END IF;
      END LOOP;
    END IF;
  END IF;

  IF NOT v_is_engine
     AND NOT v_original_abort_admission
     AND NOT v_managed_command
     AND upper(COALESCE(NEW.status, '')) IN ('CANCELLED', 'CANCELED')
     AND upper(COALESCE(OLD.status, '')) NOT IN ('CANCELLED', 'CANCELED') THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Tournament lifecycle changes must use fn_close_managed_game'
      USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;

  RETURN NEW;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.trg_freeze_finalized_tournament_prize_pool()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_delta numeric;
  v_candidate_count integer := 0;
BEGIN

  -- One owner-authorized correction: the journal binds both complete row images.
  -- No GUC alone, caller impersonation, trigger disabling or other event is admitted.
  IF TG_TABLE_NAME='tournaments' THEN
  IF current_user='postgres'
     AND OLD.id='6b72abc3-bd16-488c-aea5-54b1eace98d5'::uuid
     AND OLD.status='RUNNING' AND NEW.status='RUNNING'
     AND OLD.prize_pool=5000 AND NEW.prize_pool=4050
     AND OLD.guaranteed_prize=5000 AND NEW.guaranteed_prize=5000
     AND OLD.bounty_pool=950 AND NEW.bounty_pool=950
     AND OLD.prize_pool_finalized AND NEW.prize_pool_finalized
     AND (to_jsonb(NEW)-ARRAY['prize_pool','payout_structure'])
       =(to_jsonb(OLD)-ARRAY['prize_pool','payout_structure'])
     AND current_setting('app.owner_bounty_guarantee_correction',true)=
       'tourney:6b72abc3-bd16-488c-aea5-54b1eace98d5:owner_bounty_guarantee_20261102'
     AND EXISTS (
       SELECT 1 FROM public.chip_ledger l
       WHERE l.idempotency_key=current_setting('app.owner_bounty_guarantee_correction',true)
         AND l.tournament_id=OLD.id AND l.category='reversal' AND l.amount=950
         AND l.from_type='prize_liability' AND l.from_entity_id=OLD.id
         AND l.to_type='union_bank'
         AND l.to_entity_id='fade0000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001'::uuid
         AND l.metadata->>'kind'='owner_bounty_guarantee_correction'
         AND l.metadata->'tournament_before'=to_jsonb(OLD)
         AND l.metadata->'tournament_after'=to_jsonb(NEW)
         AND l.metadata->>'overlay_after'='1580'
         AND l.metadata->>'owner_instruction'=
           'go through and manually change the payout to the corrected 5000 prize pool and pay the overlay'
     ) THEN
    RETURN NEW;
  END IF;
  END IF;
  IF COALESCE(OLD.prize_pool_finalized, false)
     AND NOT COALESCE(NEW.prize_pool_finalized, false) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION
      'finalized tournament % prize pool cannot be reopened', NEW.id
      USING ERRCODE = 'check_violation';
  END IF;
  IF COALESCE(OLD.prize_pool_finalized, false)
     AND (NEW.payout_structure IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.payout_structure
          OR NEW.spin_multiplier IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.spin_multiplier) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION
      'finalized tournament % payout structure and Spin draw cannot change', NEW.id
      USING ERRCODE = 'check_violation';
  END IF;
  IF COALESCE(OLD.prize_pool_finalized, false)
     AND round(COALESCE(NEW.guaranteed_prize, 0), 2)
         IS DISTINCT FROM round(COALESCE(OLD.guaranteed_prize, 0), 2) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'finalized tournament % guarantee cannot change', NEW.id
      USING ERRCODE = 'check_violation';
  END IF;
  IF COALESCE(OLD.prize_pool_finalized, false)
     AND round(COALESCE(NEW.prize_pool, 0), 2)
         IS DISTINCT FROM round(COALESCE(OLD.prize_pool, 0), 2) THEN
    v_delta := round(COALESCE(OLD.prize_pool, 0) - COALESCE(NEW.prize_pool, 0), 2);

    IF v_delta > 0
       AND COALESCE(NEW.prize_pool, 0) >= 0
       AND COALESCE(NEW.prize_pool_finalized, false)
       AND OLD.status = 'COMPLETING'
       AND OLD.satellite_target_id IS NOT NULL
       AND current_setting('app.atomic_satellite_settlement', true) = OLD.id::text
       /* No second column may hitchhike on the narrowly admitted debit. */
       AND (to_jsonb(NEW) - 'prize_pool') = (to_jsonb(OLD) - 'prize_pool') THEN
      SELECT count(*)::integer
        INTO v_candidate_count
        FROM public.tournament_satellite_settlement_batches b
        JOIN public.tournament_satellite_entitlements e
          ON e.tournament_id = b.tournament_id
         AND e.target_tournament_id = b.target_tournament_id
         AND e.target_tournament_id = OLD.satellite_target_id
         AND round(e.ticket_value, 2) = v_delta
        JOIN public.tournament_players source_player
          ON source_player.tournament_id = OLD.id
         AND source_player.position = e.position
         AND source_player.status IN ('winner', 'eliminated')
        JOIN public.tournament_players target_player
          ON target_player.tournament_id = e.target_tournament_id
         AND target_player.user_id = source_player.user_id
         AND COALESCE(target_player.is_satellite_qualifier, false)
         AND target_player.source_satellite_id = OLD.id
        JOIN public.tournaments target
          ON target.id = e.target_tournament_id
       WHERE b.tournament_id = OLD.id
         AND b.settled_at IS NULL
         AND round(
               GREATEST(COALESCE(target.buy_in_amount, 0), 0)
               + GREATEST(COALESCE(target.buy_in_fee, 0), 0),
               2
             ) = v_delta
         AND (
           SELECT count(*)::integer
             FROM public.rake_records target_rake
            WHERE target_rake.tournament_id = target.id
              AND target_rake.source = 'fn_award_satellite_seat'
              AND target_rake.metadata->>'satellite_id' = OLD.id::text
              AND target_rake.metadata->>'user_id' = source_player.user_id::text
              AND target_rake.metadata->>'registration_id' = target_player.id::text
         ) = CASE WHEN COALESCE(target.buy_in_fee, 0) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
         AND (
           SELECT count(*)::integer
             FROM public.rake_records exact_target_rake
            WHERE exact_target_rake.tournament_id = target.id
              AND exact_target_rake.source = 'fn_award_satellite_seat'
              AND exact_target_rake.metadata->>'satellite_id' = OLD.id::text
              AND exact_target_rake.metadata->>'user_id' = source_player.user_id::text
              AND exact_target_rake.metadata->>'registration_id' = target_player.id::text
              AND round(exact_target_rake.rake_amount, 2)
                  = round(COALESCE(target.buy_in_fee, 0), 2)
              AND round(COALESCE(exact_target_rake.pot_size, 0), 2) = v_delta
         ) = CASE WHEN COALESCE(target.buy_in_fee, 0) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
         /* At this exact instruction the target seat exists, but the source
            payout and transfer journal do not. A replay or second debit has
            either one and therefore cannot match this predicate. */
         AND NOT EXISTS (
           SELECT 1
             FROM public.tournament_payouts payout
            WHERE payout.tournament_id = OLD.id
              AND payout.user_id = source_player.user_id
              AND payout.position = e.position
              AND payout.source = 'satellite_seat'
         )
         AND NOT EXISTS (
           SELECT 1
             FROM public.chip_ledger ledger
            WHERE ledger.idempotency_key =
              'tourney:' || OLD.id::text || ':seat:'
              || source_player.user_id::text || ':pool_transfer'
         );
    END IF;

    IF v_candidate_count = 1 THEN
      RETURN NEW;
    END IF;
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'finalized tournament % prize pool cannot change from % to %',
      NEW.id, OLD.prize_pool, NEW.prize_pool USING ERRCODE = 'check_violation';
  END IF;
  RETURN NEW;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_ca_guarantee_funding(p_tournament_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
 WITH t AS (
  SELECT x.id, round(greatest(coalesce(x.guaranteed_prize, 0), 0), 2) AS g
    FROM public.tournaments x WHERE x.id = p_tournament_id
 ), l AS (
  SELECT c.category, c.from_type, c.to_type, c.from_entity_id, c.to_entity_id, c.amount
    FROM public.chip_ledger c
   WHERE (c.to_entity_id = p_tournament_id OR c.from_entity_id = p_tournament_id)
     AND coalesce(c.status, 'posted') = 'posted'
 ), s AS (
  SELECT
   coalesce(sum(l.amount) FILTER (WHERE l.to_entity_id = p_tournament_id AND l.to_type = 'prize_liability' AND (
      (l.from_type = 'player_wallet' AND l.category IN ('tournament_buyin', 'rebuy', 'addon'))
      OR (l.from_type = 'prize_liability' AND l.category = 'tournament_buyin' AND l.from_entity_id IS DISTINCT FROM p_tournament_id)
      OR (l.from_type = 'escrow' AND l.category = 'ticket_redeem'))), 0) AS paid_in,
   coalesce(sum(l.amount) FILTER (WHERE l.from_entity_id = p_tournament_id AND l.from_type = 'prize_liability'
      AND l.to_type = 'player_wallet' AND l.category IN ('refund', 'reversal')), 0) AS paid_back,
   coalesce(sum(l.amount) FILTER (WHERE l.to_entity_id = p_tournament_id AND l.to_type = 'prize_liability'
      AND l.category IN ('overlay', 'promo_send') AND l.from_type IN ('union_bank', 'union_wallet', 'club_treasury')), 0) AS house_in,
   coalesce(sum(l.amount) FILTER (WHERE l.from_entity_id = p_tournament_id AND l.from_type = 'prize_liability'
      AND l.category = 'reversal' AND l.to_type IN ('union_bank', 'union_wallet', 'club_treasury')), 0) AS house_out
  FROM l
 ), v AS (
  SELECT t.g, round(greatest(0, s.paid_in - s.paid_back), 2) AS c, round(s.house_in - s.house_out, 2) AS p
    FROM t, s
 )
 SELECT jsonb_build_object(
  'guarantee', v.g,
  'gross_coverage', v.c,
  'house_required', greatest(0, v.g - v.c),
  'house_posted', v.p,
  'house_due', greatest(0, greatest(0, v.g - v.c) - v.p),
  'house_over_required', greatest(0, v.p - greatest(0, v.g - v.c)))
 FROM v;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_overlay_at_risk(p_union uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid)
 RETURNS TABLE(tournament_id uuid, name text, club_id uuid, status text, start_time timestamp with time zone, buy_in numeric, guaranteed_prize numeric, entries_needed integer, current_players integer, shortfall integer, max_players integer, minutes_to_start numeric)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  WITH admission AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT public.fn_ca_read_mtt_admission_contract() AS abi)
  select t.id, t.name, t.club_id, t.status, t.start_time,
         funding.charge, t.guaranteed_prize,
         coalesce(att.attendance_floor, ceil(t.guaranteed_prize / nullif(funding.charge, 0))::int),
         coalesce(t.current_players, 0),
         greatest(
           least(
             coalesce(att.attendance_floor, ceil(t.guaranteed_prize / nullif(funding.charge, 0))::int)
               - coalesce(t.current_players, 0),
             CASE WHEN a.abi='unlimited-mtt-v2' AND t.format_contract IN ('mtt-v1','mtt-v2') THEN NULL
               ELSE coalesce(t.max_players, 0) - coalesce(t.current_players, 0) END
           ), 0)::int,
         CASE WHEN a.abi='unlimited-mtt-v2' AND t.format_contract IN ('mtt-v1','mtt-v2') THEN NULL ELSE coalesce(t.max_players, 0) END,
         round(extract(epoch from (t.start_time - now())) / 60.0, 1)
  from tournaments t CROSS JOIN admission a
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL public.fn_tournament_entry_split(
    t.buy_in_amount, t.buy_in_fee, t.bounty_amount,
    COALESCE(t.is_bounty,false) OR COALESCE(t.is_pko,false)
      OR COALESCE(t.is_mystery_bounty,false)) funding
  LEFT JOIN smarter_private.nov3_tournament_attendance att ON att.tournament_id=t.id
    AND (t.start_time AT TIME ZONE 'America/Chicago')::date=DATE '2026-11-03'
  left join clubs c on c.id = t.club_id
  where (t.guaranteed_prize > 0 OR att.attendance_floor > 0)
    and funding.charge > 0
    and upper(t.status) in ('SCHEDULED', 'REGISTERING', 'ANNOUNCED', 'RUNNING')
    and t.start_time > now() - interval '30 minutes'
    and t.start_time < now() + interval '3 hours'
    and (p_union is null or c.union_id = p_union or c.id = p_union)
    and coalesce(att.attendance_floor, ceil(t.guaranteed_prize / nullif(funding.charge, 0))::int) > coalesce(t.current_players, 0)
  order by t.start_time asc;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_tournament_guarantee_check(p_hours integer DEFAULT 24)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_checked   integer := 0;
  v_short     integer := 0;
  v_unpaid    integer := 0;
  v_chips     numeric := 0;
  v_raised    integer := 0;
  r           record;
BEGIN
  FOR r IN
    WITH scope AS (
      SELECT t.id, t.name, t.club_id, t.guaranteed_prize,
             COALESCE(t.total_rake, 0) AS rake,
             COALESCE(t.prize_pool, 0) AS pool,
             /* THE BUBBLE IS PAID FROM THE GUARANTEED POOL (2026-10-03). A
                bubble-protected event reserves one base buy-in for its stone
                bubble out of the prize pool before the ladder is priced, and
                says so on the event page. That refund is part of what the
                guarantee paid out, as is an overlay backpay that made a short
                pool whole. Leaving them out read f84852af (Sunday $200 Deep
                Stack, 2026-09-27: 19,820.00 to places 1-2 plus 180.00 to the
                bubble, 20,000.00 in all) as 180.00 short, and 690bfcb0 on
                2026-09-14 the same way. */
             COALESCE((
               SELECT sum(p.amount) FROM public.tournament_payouts p
                WHERE p.tournament_id = t.id
                  AND p.source IN ('structure','reconcile','hu_shortfall',
                                   'late_reg_adjustment','final_table_deal',
                                   'spin_backpay','bubble_protection',
                                   'overlay_backpay')
             ), 0) + COALESCE(t.bounty_pool_paid, 0) AS paid,
             EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.tournament_guarantee_overlays o
                      WHERE o.tournament_id = t.id) AS overlay_funded,
             t.ended_at
        FROM public.tournaments t
       WHERE COALESCE(t.guaranteed_prize, 0) > 0
         AND t.status = 'COMPLETED'
         AND t.ended_at > now() - make_interval(hours => GREATEST(p_hours, 1))
         AND COALESCE(t.variant, '') <> 'satellite'
         AND UPPER(COALESCE(t.tournament_type, '')) <> 'SATELLITE'
    )
    SELECT * FROM scope
  LOOP
    v_checked := v_checked + 1;

    -- Rounded to the cent before comparing: the payout structure distributes
    -- in basis points with the residual on the last paid place, so an exact
    -- equality test would report a phantom shortfall of a fraction of a chip.
    -- A BUY-IN GUARANTEE COUNTS THE WHOLE PLAYER PAYMENT (owner
    -- 2026-11-05): the rake the players paid is part of what met it.
    CONTINUE WHEN round(r.paid + r.rake, 2) >= round(r.guaranteed_prize, 2);

    v_short := v_short + 1;
    v_chips := v_chips + (r.guaranteed_prize - r.paid - r.rake);
    IF r.paid = 0 THEN v_unpaid := v_unpaid + 1; END IF;

    -- One alert per event, ever. Re-running this hourly must not manufacture
    -- a new critical for the same settled tournament.
    IF NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM public.financial_alerts a
       WHERE a.source = 'Tournament.guarantee_not_met'
         AND a.context ->> 'tournament_id' = r.id::text
    ) THEN
      INSERT INTO public.financial_alerts (severity, source, message, context)
      VALUES (
        CASE WHEN r.paid = 0 THEN 'critical' ELSE 'warning' END,
        'Tournament.guarantee_not_met',
        CASE WHEN r.paid = 0
          THEN 'A tournament advertised a guaranteed prize, crowned its field, and paid nobody anything.'
          ELSE 'A tournament paid out less than its advertised guaranteed prize.'
        END,
        jsonb_build_object(
          'tournament_id',    r.id,
          'tournament_name',  r.name,
          'club_id',          r.club_id,
          'guaranteed_prize', r.guaranteed_prize,
          'prize_pool',       r.pool,
          'actually_paid',    r.paid,
          'shortfall',        round(r.guaranteed_prize - r.paid - r.rake, 2),
          'rake',             r.rake,
          'overlay_funded',   r.overlay_funded,
          'ended_at',         r.ended_at
        )
      );
      v_raised := v_raised + 1;
    END IF;
  END LOOP;

  RETURN jsonb_build_object(
    'ok', true,
    'window_hours', GREATEST(p_hours, 1),
    'checked', v_checked,
    'short_of_guarantee', v_short,
    'paid_nothing', v_unpaid,
    'chips_short', round(v_chips, 2),
    'alerts_raised', v_raised
  );
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_audit_overlays(p_day date)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE v jsonb := '[]'::jsonb; r record; total numeric := 0; gross numeric := 0; n integer := 0;
BEGIN
  FOR r IN
    WITH eligible AS MATERIALIZED (
      SELECT t.id,t.name,t.guaranteed_prize gtd,t.buy_in_amount bi,
             coalesce(t.prize_pool,0) pool,
             -- The whole payment is credited toward the guarantee (Dan,
             -- 2026-11-05): fee per entry, and bounties + rake in the pools.
             coalesce(t.buy_in_fee,0) fee,
             coalesce(t.bounty_pool,0)+coalesce(t.total_rake,0) pool_credit,
             (SELECT count(*) FROM public.tournament_players p WHERE p.tournament_id=t.id) entries
      FROM public.tournaments t
      WHERE t.guaranteed_prize>0 AND t.buy_in_amount>0
        AND t.started_at >= p_day::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'
        AND t.started_at < (p_day+1)::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'
    ), funded AS (
      SELECT e.*,
        coalesce((SELECT sum(l.amount) FROM public.chip_ledger l
          WHERE l.tournament_id=e.id AND l.category='overlay'
            AND l.to_type='prize_liability'),0) journal,
        coalesce((SELECT o.amount FROM public.tournament_guarantee_overlays o
          WHERE o.tournament_id=e.id),0) legacy,
        -- The live path's own return of an overlay the field outgrew.
        coalesce((SELECT sum(l.amount) FROM public.chip_ledger l
          WHERE l.tournament_id=e.id AND l.category='reversal'
            AND l.from_type='prize_liability'
            AND l.description LIKE 'Guarantee overlay excess returned%'),0) returned
      FROM eligible e
    ), measured AS (
      -- Same funding precedence as tournament conservation: two records of
      -- one funding are never added together. Net is what the house kept in.
      SELECT f.*,greatest(journal,legacy,0) funding,
             greatest(greatest(journal,legacy,0)-returned,0) net_funding,
             greatest(gtd-greatest(entries*(bi+fee),pool+pool_credit),0) entry_only_gap FROM funded f
    ), counted AS (
      SELECT m.*,sum(net_funding) OVER () all_net,sum(funding) OVER () all_gross,
             count(*) FILTER (WHERE net_funding>0) OVER () funded_events,
             count(*) FILTER (WHERE funding=0 AND entry_only_gap>0) OVER () unconfirmed_events
      FROM measured m WHERE funding>0 OR entry_only_gap>0
    )
    SELECT * FROM counted ORDER BY net_funding DESC,funding DESC,entry_only_gap DESC,id LIMIT 10
  LOOP
    total:=r.all_net; gross:=r.all_gross; n:=r.funded_events;
    v:=v||jsonb_build_object(
      'severity',CASE WHEN r.net_funding>=200 THEN 'critical'
                      WHEN r.net_funding>0 OR (r.funding=0 AND r.entry_only_gap>0) THEN 'warn'
                      ELSE 'info' END,
      'category','logic',
      'code',CASE WHEN r.net_funding>0 THEN 'tournament_overlay'
                  WHEN r.funding>0 THEN 'tournament_overlay_returned'
                  ELSE 'tournament_overlay_estimate' END,
      'title',CASE WHEN r.net_funding>0 THEN r.name||' cost '||round(r.net_funding,2)||' in guarantee overlay'
                   WHEN r.funding>0 THEN r.name||' funded '||round(r.funding,2)||' of guarantee overlay and returned it all'
                   ELSE r.name||' has an entry-only gap with unconfirmed funding' END,
      'evidence',jsonb_build_object('tournament_id',r.id,'guarantee',r.gtd,'buy_in',r.bi,
        'entries',r.entries,'prize_pool',r.pool,'entry_only_gap',r.entry_only_gap,
        'funded_overlay',r.funding,'returned_overlay',r.returned,'net_overlay',r.net_funding,
        'journal_overlay',r.journal,'legacy_overlay',r.legacy,
        'funding_confirmed',r.funding>0,'basis','net_recorded_funding',
        'funded_events',r.funded_events,'unconfirmed_events',r.unconfirmed_events),
      'recommendation',CASE WHEN r.net_funding>0 THEN
        'Net guarantee funding is the house cost after the live path''s own return of any excess. It is an honoured guarantee, not proof of an overlay-guard defect; trace the pre-start eligibility and registration decisions before diagnosing the guard.'
        WHEN r.funding>0 THEN
        'The field outgrew the guarantee after start and the live path returned the whole overlay to the bank that funded it. Nothing was spent and nothing needs deciding.'
        ELSE 'This is an estimate from the larger of entries x (buy-in + fee) and the whole payment credited (places + bounties + rake), not money proved paid. Inspect original funding and entry receipts before claiming an overlay or diagnosing the guard.' END);
  END LOOP;
  IF jsonb_array_length(v)>0 THEN
    v:=v||jsonb_build_object('severity','info','category','logic','code','overlay_total',
      'title','Net guarantee overlay: '||round(total,2)||' across '||n||' event(s) ('||round(gross,2)||' funded before returns)',
      'evidence',jsonb_build_object('events',n,'total_overlay',round(total,2),'gross_funding',round(gross,2),
        'basis','net_recorded_funding','detail_limit',10),
      'recommendation','Total includes every event started in the UTC day, including events beyond the ten displayed details. Net is recorded funding minus the live path''s recorded return of excess; entry-only estimates are excluded.');
  END IF;
  RETURN v;
END
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_notify_guarantee_bank_short(p_club_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
declare
  v_union uuid; v_club_name text; v_union_name text;
  v_bank numeric; v_bank_label text; v_exposure numeric;
  v_recipients uuid[]; v_uid uuid; v_inserted integer := 0;
  v_title text; v_message text;
begin
  select c.union_id, c.name into v_union, v_club_name
    from public.clubs c where c.id = p_club_id;
  if not found then
    return jsonb_build_object('ok', false, 'reason', 'club_not_found');
  end if;

  if v_union is not null then
    select coalesce(uw.chip_balance, 0), u.name
      into v_bank, v_union_name
      from public.unions u
      left join public.union_wallets uw on uw.union_id = u.id
     where u.id = v_union;
    v_bank_label := 'union bank';

    -- The promises the publish guard (fn_tournament_management_readiness_for_row)
    -- counts against this bank, read the same way: guaranteed prizes AND
    -- guaranteed satellite seats, net of the whole player payment already
    -- collected (places + bounties + rake, Dan 2026-11-05).
    select coalesce(sum(greatest(
             greatest(
               coalesce(t.guaranteed_prize, 0) - (coalesce(t.prize_pool, 0) + coalesce(t.bounty_pool, 0) + coalesce(t.total_rake, 0)),
               case
                 when coalesce(t.satellite_seats, 0) > 0
                      and (
                        lower(coalesce(t.variant, '')) = 'satellite'
                        or upper(coalesce(t.tournament_type, '')) = 'SATELLITE'
                        or coalesce(t.satellite_target_id, t.satellite_target) is not null
                      )
                 then coalesce(
                   (coalesce(target.buy_in_amount, 0) + coalesce(target.buy_in_fee, 0))
                   * t.satellite_seats,
                   0
                 ) - coalesce(t.prize_pool, 0)
                 else 0
               end
             ),
             0
           )), 0)
      into v_exposure
      from public.tournaments t
      left join public.tournaments target
        on target.id = coalesce(t.satellite_target_id, t.satellite_target)
     where t.union_id = v_union
       and not coalesce(t.is_private, false)
       and coalesce(t.prize_pool_finalized,false) = false
       and upper(t.status::text) in ('ANNOUNCED','REGISTERING','RUNNING');

    select array_agg(distinct uid) into v_recipients from (
      select u.owner_id as uid from public.unions u where u.id = v_union and u.owner_id is not null
      union
      select c.owner_id from public.clubs c where c.id = p_club_id and c.owner_id is not null
    ) o;
  else
    select coalesce(c.chip_treasury, 0) into v_bank
      from public.clubs c where c.id = p_club_id;
    v_bank_label := 'club bank';

    select coalesce(sum(greatest(
             greatest(
               coalesce(t.guaranteed_prize, 0) - (coalesce(t.prize_pool, 0) + coalesce(t.bounty_pool, 0) + coalesce(t.total_rake, 0)),
               case
                 when coalesce(t.satellite_seats, 0) > 0
                      and (
                        lower(coalesce(t.variant, '')) = 'satellite'
                        or upper(coalesce(t.tournament_type, '')) = 'SATELLITE'
                        or coalesce(t.satellite_target_id, t.satellite_target) is not null
                      )
                 then coalesce(
                   (coalesce(target.buy_in_amount, 0) + coalesce(target.buy_in_fee, 0))
                   * t.satellite_seats,
                   0
                 ) - coalesce(t.prize_pool, 0)
                 else 0
               end
             ),
             0
           )), 0)
      into v_exposure
      from public.tournaments t
      left join public.tournaments target
        on target.id = coalesce(t.satellite_target_id, t.satellite_target)
     where t.club_id = p_club_id
       and (coalesce(t.is_private, false) or t.union_id is null)
       and coalesce(t.prize_pool_finalized,false) = false
       and upper(t.status::text) in ('ANNOUNCED','REGISTERING','RUNNING');

    select array_agg(c.owner_id) into v_recipients
      from public.clubs c where c.id = p_club_id and c.owner_id is not null;
  end if;

  v_title := 'More Chips Needed To Cover Guarantees';
  v_message := 'The ' || v_bank_label || ' for '
            || coalesce(case when v_union is not null then v_union_name end, v_club_name, 'your club')
            || ' holds ' || round(v_bank, 2)
            || ' chips against ' || round(v_exposure, 2)
            || ' promised in live guarantees. New guaranteed tournaments cannot start until more chips are added to the bank.';

  foreach v_uid in array coalesce(v_recipients, '{}'::uuid[]) loop
    if not exists (
      select 1 from public.notifications n
       where n.user_id = v_uid
         and n.type = 'guarantee_bank_short'
         and coalesce(n.is_read, false) = false
         and n.data->>'bank_entity_id' = coalesce(v_union, p_club_id)::text
    ) then
      insert into public.notifications (user_id, type, title, message, data, is_read)
      values (v_uid, 'guarantee_bank_short', v_title, v_message,
              jsonb_build_object(
                'bank_type', case when v_union is not null then 'union' else 'club' end,
                'bank_entity_id', coalesce(v_union, p_club_id),
                'club_id', p_club_id, 'union_id', v_union,
                'bank_balance', v_bank, 'live_exposure', v_exposure,
                'short_by', round(greatest(v_exposure - v_bank, 0), 2)),
              false);
      v_inserted := v_inserted + 1;
    end if;
  end loop;

  return jsonb_build_object('ok', true, 'notified', v_inserted,
    'bank', v_bank, 'exposure', v_exposure,
    'recipients', coalesce(array_length(v_recipients, 1), 0));
end;
$function$
